title: A multiplicative universal property for real algebraic $K$-theory
summary: We prove that the real $K$-theory functor is lax symmetric monoidal. Moreover, it is initial among those real functors $\mathsf{Wald}_\infty^\mathrm{gd}\to\mathsf{Sp}^{C_2}$ that are additive and lax symmetric monoidal.
